meta.purpose: Unit costs for body-shop / assembly-line investment comparison (portfolio sim). Public sources only.

fx.basis: 2025 annual average USD/KRW (Seoul FX market close, reported 2025-12-30)
fx.note: All USD figures converted at this single rate. No inflation adjustment applied - older USD figures (2005/2014) are nominal of their year.

applicability_legend.direct: measures the same thing in a comparable setting
applicability_legend.proxy: related measure; needs an assumption to use

items.name: Spot-welding robot system, installed (robot + gun + controller + peripherals + systems engineering), per robot

source.title: How Robots Will Redefine Competitiveness (The Robotics Revolution series)
source.publisher: Boston Consulting Group (M. Zinser, J. Rose, H. Sirkin)
source.quote: The total cost of purchasing and deploying a robotics system for spot welding in the U.S. automotive industry plunged from an average of $182,000 in 2005 to $133,000 in 2014 ... [projected] around $103,000 [by 2025]. Systems engineering ... around $46,000 [2014] vs $81,000 a decade earlier.

items.note: Direct: US automotive spot-welding system average incl. integration. Not Korea-specific, not a 200 kg class robot specifically; high value is a 2005 price, used only as an upper bound.

supporting.what: Average industrial robot ARM price (all types, hardware only)
supporting.derivation: IFR market value of installations US$16.5 bn / 541,302 units installed in 2023
supporting.note: Excludes software, peripherals and systems engineering; average over all robot sizes, so a 200 kg spot-welding robot arm is above it. Useful only as a floor / arm share check (~16-23% of BCG system cost).

items.name: Manual final-assembly / trim station (conveyor section + tooling + fixtures), per station
items.note: NOT FOUND. No official/statistical/academic public source giving a per-station cost for a manual trim/final-assembly station was found within the time budget. Only vendor/marketing blogs (automated cells, conveyor 'thousands of dollars per foot') turned up; not used. If needed, derive from item 4 (plant capex per unit capacity) with an explicit, labelled assumption on share of capex in the assembly shop and number of stations.

items.name: Annual labour cost per production worker, Korean auto OEM

low.kind: wage only, KSIC C301 engine & motor vehicle mfg, annual pay per worker

typical.kind: Kia avg pay per employee (all staff), wage only

high.kind: derived: Kia avg pay x 1.251 employer loading

sources.publisher: Kia (DART/KIND 사업보고서), reported by Financial News
sources.note: Company disclosure. Average over all employees (production + office + R&D), wage only (no employer social insurance / retirement).

sources.what: Hyundai Motor 2025 사업보고서 직원 평균 급여 1억3,100만원 (2024: 1억2,400만원)
KSIC C301 자동차용 엔진 및 자동차 제조업 1인당 연간급여액 85.2백만원 (2022); C30 전체 57.8백만원
sources.publisher: 통계청 광업제조업조사 (KOSIS), tabulated in 자동차ISC '2024 자동차산업 인력현황 조사·분석' 표-16
sources.note: Official statistics, 10+ employee establishments, finished-vehicle makers. 2022 value (older).

sources.what: KSIC C30 자동차 및 트레일러 제조업 월평균 임금 532.4만원 (2022) = 63.9백만원/년
sources.publisher: 고용노동부 사업체노동력조사 (KOSIS), same ISC report p.37
sources.note: Whole auto industry incl. parts suppliers - too low for an OEM line; shown for context only.

sources.what: Employer loading: 1인당 월평균 노동비용 636.1만원 = 직접 508.5만원 + 간접 127.6만원 -> total/direct = 1.251 (2024 회계연도, 10인 이상 전산업; 300인 이상 775.2만원, 제조업 722.1만원)
sources.note: All-industry ratio used as the multiplier from pay to employer cost (social insurance, retirement, welfare, training).

items.shift_note: Hyundai/Kia domestic plants run two daytime-continuous shifts (주간연속2교대). A station staffed on both shifts costs 2 x (per-worker cost) per year before any relief/absence allowance; the relief factor was not sourced and is left to the model as an explicit assumption.

items.name: New vehicle plant / line investment per unit of annual capacity

cases.plant: Kia Hwaseong PBV plant (EVO Plant East), groundbreaking announcement
cases.note: Announced ~1조, 'up to 15만 대'. Later reporting (2025-11) gives East = 10만 대/yr PV5 -> 10.0M KRW per unit if 1조 is East only.

cases.plant: Kia Hwaseong EVO Plant complex (East + West + PBV conversion center)
cases.note: 4조 includes R&D, not just plant capex -> upper bound.
Company announcement: ~2조 new investment, 20만 대/yr, SOP 2026 Q1. Full plant (press, body, paint, GA).

cases.plant: Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America (HMGMA), Georgia
cases.publisher: Georgia Department of Economic Development (georgia.org); capacity also in HMG release 2025-03-26
cases.note: Greenfield US site incl. land/infrastructure; scope of $7.59B vs battery JV not stated precisely. Not used for low/typical/high - shown as a greenfield-overseas upper reference.

items.small_line_rule: Rough fixed cost of a small dedicated line = capacity x KRW/unit-capacity. E.g. 50,000 cars/yr x 10.0M = 5,000억 KRW (range 3,333억-8,000억 with low/high). These are whole-plant ratios (press+body+paint+GA+buildings); a single shop or a line added in an existing plant costs less - treat as rough.
items.note: Low/typical/high from Korean domestic announcements only (Kia PBV 1조/15만, Hyundai Ulsan 2조/20만, Kia EVO 4조/25만 incl. R&D).

items.name: Operating profit per wholesale vehicle (value of one lost car)

cases.publisher: Kia via Hyundai Motor Group newsroom
Kia via Hyundai Motor Group newsroom

items.note: Consolidated operating profit / wholesale units. This is a LOWER BOUND for contribution margin (CM excludes fixed cost, so CM per car > OP per car); Hyundai's consolidated OP also contains its finance segment. 2025 is depressed by US tariffs.
